snippets.BUGSY_CATALOGUE_01: Take heed, superheroes! Bugsy has landed! Although this long-eared Pokopet is related to the rabbit, he's anything but shy and quiet. Bugsy comes outfitted with his own cape. Sometimes he likes to cuddle up in it and if he's feeling a bit emotional, he might use it as a tissue. Because of his excellent jumping abilities, this Pokopet is a first-rate jump roper. It's a bird, it's a plane, it's Bugsy!
snippets.CATALOGUES_BOLLY_1L:
About Bollys
Bollys are small, friendly pets that are easy to cuddle. They are affectionate and like to chat a lot and love it when a Panda takes care of them.
All Pandas with Gold packages can adopt a bolly. Members can adopt up to five of the little creatures in all colours.
There are five different kinds of Bolly, each with its very own distinct personality. In this catalogue, you can read about what characteristics they have, how you can adopt them and how to feed and care for them so that they develop well.
snippets.CATALOGUES_BOLLY_1R_2: Character: Is always in a good mood and happy to play Favourite pastime: Playing with rockets
snippets.CATALOGUES_BOLLY_2L_2: Character: Can sometimes be a bit cheeky, but is also happy to cuddle Favourite pastime: Blowing soap-bubbles
snippets.CATALOGUES_BOLLY_2R_2: Character: Has an especially strong personality but has a tendency to be in a bad mood sometimes. Favourite pastime: Going for a walk
snippets.CATALOGUES_BOLLY_3L_2: Character: Is a bit bashful and timid but very lovable. Favourite pastime: Eating
snippets.CATALOGUES_BOLLY_3R_2: Character: Doesn't get irritated by anything but can be a bit lazy. Favourite pastime: Sleeping
snippets.CATALOGUES_BOLLY_4R:
How to care for your Bolly
When you adopt a Bolly from the catalogue, go back to your treehouse. It will be waiting for you there.
When you click on your Bolly, its player card will appear. A picture of it on the card will show you what mood it is in. Under the picture you'll see three bars telling you if your Bolly is hungry, well rested or if it wants to sleep. The more green bars present, the better your Bolly feels.
Your Bolly will tell you what it wants but only in Spanish. If you ignore it for a longer time it may run away.
snippets.CATALOGUES_BOLLY_5L:
How to feed your Bolly
When your Bolly is hungry, you must feed it. Your Bolly will do best when you give it healthy Bolly food. You feed it by clicking on the Feed symbol on its card.
snippets.CATALOGUES_BOLLY_6L:
How to play with your Bolly
Play with your Bolly, then it'll stay healthy! When your Bolly is well rested (you'll know because the Energy bar on its player card will be in green) then it will gladly play when you click on the Play symbol on its card.
How to get your Bolly to rest
When your Bolly's Rest bar is red that means it's tired and must rest. While it's resting, you must click on the symbol of the sleeping Bolly on its player card. Then it will rest properly and wake up refreshed. Make sure your Bolly doesn't sleep too much though – that's also unhealthy in the long run!
snippets.CATALOGUES_BOLLY_7L:
How to take your Bolly for a walk
When you want to go walking with your Bolly, simply click on the footprint symbol on its player card. When you walk around Panfu, it will accompany you.
First though, check out your Bolly's health bars, whether it's well-rested and fed. If so, then a walk will do your Bolly good and you'll both have fun!
You can only ever go walking with one Bolly at a time. Make sure all your pets regularly get out into the fresh air!
snippets.CATALOGUES_BOLLY_8L:
What happens to my Bolly when I'm not on Panfu?
When you leave your treehouse to go and have fun on Panfu, your Bolly will still get hungry and tired and want to play so you should still check on it from time to time to make sure it's alright.
When you're not on Panfu, then your Bolly will go into downtime mode. That means that it will stay in exactly the same condition you left it in until you return to Panfu. During this time, it will not get hungry or sleepy nor need to play.

snippets.CUDDLES_CATALOGUE_01: This hedgehog cousin hails from the forests of Eastern Europe. The Cuddles have an excellent sense of smell, which more than makes up for their relatively poor sight. But even that is no hindrance, for each Cuddle has been outfited with its own pair of glasses. Now they can see the smallest ant or the biggest vegetables. Vegetables? Why, of course! Their favorite food is carrots - the bigger, the better. When confronted with danger, the Cuddles roll up into balls and stick out their quills. It can make for quite the prickly situation for any predator!

snippets.HELMET_CATALOGUE_01: These little critters always have an eye out for safety. Helmet turtles - or Helmets for short - are covered from head to toe in armor. Hence the name! snippets.HOTBOMB_EXPLANATION:
Check out the Hot Boom game! The game starts when at least 3 pandas are in the room. One random panda will get the Hot Bomb randomly in the beginning while the countdown starts. There are only 2 rules: - The panda who got the Hot Bomb needs to throw it quickly to another Panda, or it will explode. - The panda with the Hot Bomb loses as soon as the countdown has expired.
Have fun!

snippets.NARRATOR_11: Finally, after so long, Amalura and Joshua are reunited. Perhaps you will see the two lovers on the volcano watching the sunset. You have really helped them. But not only Joshua and Amalura. You have rescued Panfu from an evil curse! We are very proud of you that you have solved these difficult tasks. snippets.SOQUE_CATALOGUE_01: As you can see, Soques are related to the red fox. They are extremely clever animals and can trick their predators using the bells on their tails. If they think they are in danger, a Soque will ring its bells to both irritate and distract. They can also blow up their heads to three times their natural size! That's enough to scare anyone off!
snippets.STELLA_CATALOGUE_01: These birds of paradise hail from the Amazonian rainforests. The Stellas are a cute, happy, and dreamy species. They love to dance in circles and their favorite food is plums, which make them especially nimble. They are known for their loud calls, but be careful: one scream from a Stella can send a wave of shock to anyone nearby, freezing them temporarily.

snippets.WOODY_CATALOGUE_01:
The Woodys' natural habitat is a volcanic island off the coast of China. They love to eat chili pepper candy and can even spit out little balls of fire. To protect them from predators, the Woodys have dragon antlers that they can make shoot out of the ground on command. If a predator comes near, these little horns shoot right up to block it while the Woody makes its escape.
Woodys can only be purchased using a Pokopet voucher. You can get one by successfully completing the 'Save the Pokopets' quest.

snippets.PILLAR_TEXT_1:
Our moderators can follow the chat for security reasons. If you break the rules, you risk losing your account forever.
Abusing the reporting feature will also be punished. If you don't want to see a panda anymore, block them instead.
snippets.PILLAR_TEXT_2: Rules: 1. Never be mean, bully or treat the other pandas in a bad way. 2. Do not spam messages, emotes or actions. 3. Do not use cheats to gain advantages.
snippets.PILLAR_TEXT_3:
Chat commands
- bla/unbla - getrooms - goto (ballroom, bookworm, booster, chillroom, cloudroom, court, disco, kamaria, library, paul, town) - moveto (1-151) - moonwalk/pop
snippets.PILLAR_TEXT_4: 4. Never exchange personal information. 5. Do not abuse bugs in the game. 6. Do not advertise other websites.

snippets.HELP_DIALOG: Your Panda Level shows how long you've played at Panfu. The more you play, the higher your level will be. For each new level, you'll get access to new features and locations. Take a look at the list.
snippets.LEVEL_CAP_EXPLANATION: From here onwards, only Gold Pandas will get a reward for each new level. Non-Gold Pandas will get a new feature on the levels marked in white.
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_1: This is the level where all pandas begin. Spend some time playing games and taking a look around and you will reach Level 2 before you know it!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_10: Your dance suit is complete! Your panda can now dance! Would you like to dance in the disco or on the street? Both are possible!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_11: Magic straight from Kamaria's potion box: At this level you can transform into a cloud of green smoke, but fortunately not for ever! After a few seconds you'll return back into your normal Panda-self.
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_12: You've been playing in Panfu for a long time. How about a reward? A new treehouse? Or perhaps a new, wacky outfit? Here are 2000 Panda coins, so get shopping!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_13: Ready for a little dose of responsibility? At this level you get your own rare, colorful Bolly!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_14: Ewww! Now you can transform yourself into a spider! Scare the Panda-pants off of your arachnophobic friends!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_15: Now you can have the last laugh! Throw green slime at other pandas! If you aim right, they will be paralyzed until the green slime slides off them!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_16: Welcome to level 16! Go into the pet store. You can play all the games that you find there!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_17: Wow, you're already at Level 17! At this level you will get to be a prince or princess. Have fun reigning!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_18: You're now a skipper! Now you can throw a lightning bolt at other Pandas!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_19: Congratulations! You get a police outfit at this level!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_2: At this level you gain access to the Beauty Salon in San Franpanfu! In the salon there is a catwalk where you can model your clothes for your friends.
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_20: Super cool! As an antelope you can temporarily freeze other Pandas in a block of ice!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_21: Welcome to level 21! You can now dress up as a thief! Don't cause too much mischief!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_22: At this level you'll get a new skill: transform other pandas temporarily into little chickens!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_23: You have received a new rocket! Show how you feel with the new love-rocket!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_24: Have fun skating around Panfu with your new pair of rollerblades! But remember - no skating in the treehouse!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_25: Smells like something snuck out from behind you. Rip one for your friends or fart just for you to your heart's content!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_26: Gone with the wind! You'll be blown away when you get caught in this cyclone!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_27: You have finally earned a super-cute, super-cuddly, super-golden Bolly! Impress the neighbors, but remember to take good care of it.
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_28: Want to send a very special message to that very special someone? Put away that love poem and send your heart instead!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_29: Woah! Hold on to your trousers because now you are a Monster-farter!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_3: Hold your breath and open your eyes! The new Player Card Background is just the thing for all keen swimmers among the Pandas. With this, you'll even be able compete with turtles.
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_30: Walking is so 20th century. Now you can beam yourself. Finally!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_31: Hope you're not afraid of heights, because here's a parachute just for you! Put it on and jump from the volcano. Where you land, nobody knows!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_32: These winged-sneakers will make you the fastest Panda in all of Panfu! Unless the other Panda happens to have the same shoes. Rush around and show everyone what a hurry you're in!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_33: You are now the Master of Slime! Throw three slime bombs in a row and show those Pandas who's boss!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_34: Transform yourself into a cute, little bunny-rabbit and jump around just for the fun of it!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_35: You are now a master thief! Disappear straight into the ground for a quick get-away.
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_36: Who is the fairest panda in all the land? You! Put on your new clothes and see for yourself!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_37: Your powers are growing! Make yourself invisible for a few seconds.
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_38: You are now the ruler of ice! Freeze three pandas at once into an ice-block.
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_39: Finally you can scare them all! You now have an excellent ghost costume. Boo!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_4: A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush. But nobody can top an Owl on your shoulder! Congratulations, you now have a new feathery friend!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_40: The cosiest treehouse ever! You can't buy it anywhere but now you've earned it! Have fun and be proud!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_41: Feel the power-flower power! Let your buddies know you care with the new flower emoticon!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_42: Which bear is second-cutest after the panda? That's right: the koala bear! With the koala costume, you're sure to be all the rage down under!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_43: Ahh, what is that lovely jingling? It's the sound of 5,000 Panda coins! Have fun shopping!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_44: Are you the dark and mysterious type? Bewilder all your friends by walking around in a cloud of fog!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_45: Ever wish you could spit fire while swooshing around a tail? Now you can with this fabulous dragon costume!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_46: Get ready to say "I do" with the new engagement emoticon!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_47: Ay, ay, captain! With your new player's card background, you'll go down in Panfu history!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_48: Bust a move on the dance floor! From now on, you know an all new dance. Go ahead, have a dance-off!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_49: Here is a lovely light-blue Wooby for you! Take care of her well and she'll be a friend for life.
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_5: You can now throw a limited number of fireworks every day. That looks fantastic!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_50: Ta da! Wow, a new treehouse background just for you! Invite all your friends and celebrate the occasion!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_51: Shake your head, rocking Panda! With these guitar riffs, nobody will be able to keep their head still. The new dance move is called "Head Bang" and isn't for the fainthearted Panda!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_52: New York? Tokio? Berlin? Experience big city feeling with this Penthouse treehouse. Panoramic view included!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_53: It lives on land as well as in water, grows very old and always carries its home around - the turtle. With the Costume, you can now put yourself in the shoes of this cute animal. But be careful: A turtle is also very sloooooow.
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_54: Hmmm...you should take a closer look at that. With the new Detective Smiley, everyone will see who's in the know. Solving riddles has just become even more fun!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_55: Let flowers rain down! You will delight every Panda heart with the new Flower Fireworks. Make sure to check your level functions for it!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_56: Here's looking at you, Panda! This Goldfish is more than a nice decorational piece for your treehouse. His favourite pastime: staring at you with his googly eyes!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_57: You have noticed a cute Panda, but are too shy to talk to him or her? The Whistling Smiley might just do the trick!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_58: Bring a little bit of Australia to Panfu with your new Kangaroo Costume. Put it on and get hopping!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_59: Mirror, mirror on the wall, who is the richest Panda of them all? With 8000 additional Panda coins in your pocket, the answer might just be: you!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_6: You're well on your way to becoming a Panfu veteran. As a reward, here are 1,000 Panda coins. Buy something nice or save up to buy something really nice!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_60: Beep! Beep! You can now transform into a roller skating robot for a little while. Get set, go! Psst ... see what happens when you write "dnd" in the chat.
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_7: Pandas are exceptional dancers! But you need the right outfit. In this level you can get the first part of your dance outfit!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_8: Magic! At this level you can transform yourself temporarily into a tiny mouse!
snippets.LEVEL_DESCRIPTION_9: Congratulations! You've now received the second part of your dance outfit. There is only one part left until you'll be able to tear up the dance floor!

snippets.WOOD_PANDA_LEVEL_CAP: Congratulations! You have reached Level 5 and are now a Goldy! To keep playing as a Gold Panda, you'll need the Gold Package.
snippets.WOOD_PANDA_LEVEL_CAP2: Congratulations! You have reached Level 16! From now on, only Gold Pandas will continue receiving new features with each new level. Non-Gold Pandas will get a new feature every 3-5 levels.

snippets.SNF_BLOCKED_PROFILE_POPUP: Your profile has been blocked by a moderator because you did not keep to the rules when entering information. You will not be able to edit your profile for another $$minutes$$ minutes.
